title: What to ask after an argument (that actually helps)

slides.title: What to ask *after an argument*
slides.sub: Wait until you’re both calm. Then go in this order.

slides.text: What did you *need from me* in that moment?
slides.tip: Don’t defend yourself. Just hear it.

slides.text: What did I say that *hurt the most?*
slides.tip: Then apologize for that part, specifically.

slides.text: Is there anything you *still need to say?*
slides.tip: Leave space. A little silence is okay.

slides.text: What can we do *differently* next time?
slides.tip: Pick one small change you’ll both actually keep.
Ask it. Mean it. Then hug it out.

slides.title: Save this *for the next hard talk.*
slides.sub: You won’t remember these mid-argument. That’s what saving is for.
